passages.sermon:
This is a song.
People sang this song while going up to Jerusalem.
They called it a song of ascents.

passages.text: I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents.
I lift up my eyes.
I look toward the hills.
I ask a question.
Where does my help come from?
passages.original: שִׁ֗יר לַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֣א עֵ֭ינַי אֶל־ הֶהָרִ֑ים מֵ֝אַ֗יִן יָבֹ֥א עֶזְרִֽי׃

passages.text: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD helps me.
The LORD made heaven.
The LORD made earth.
The LORD is my helper.
passages.original: עֶ֭זְרִי מֵעִ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
passages.sermon: The LORD is your Protector.\r\nHe will not let your foot slip.\r\nYour Protector does not slumber.
passages.original: אַל־ יִתֵּ֣ן לַמּ֣וֹט רַגְלֶ֑ךָ אַל־ יָ֝נ֗וּם שֹֽׁמְרֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
passages.sermon:
God protects Israel.
God does not slumber.
God does not sleep.
God always watches over Israel.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֣ה לֹֽא־ יָ֭נוּם וְלֹ֣א יִישָׁ֑ן שׁוֹמֵ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your keeper.
The LORD protects you.
The LORD stands beside you.
The LORD is the shade at your right hand.
passages.original: יְהוָ֥ה שֹׁמְרֶ֑ךָ יְהוָ֥ה צִ֝לְּךָ֗ עַל־ יַ֥ד יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
passages.sermon: The LORD protects you.\r\nThe sun will not harm you during the day.\r\nThe moon will not harm you at night.
passages.original: יוֹמָ֗ם הַשֶּׁ֥מֶשׁ לֹֽא־ יַכֶּ֗כָּה וְיָרֵ֥חַ בַּלָּֽיְלָה׃

passages.text: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your protector.
The LORD will keep you safe from all evil.
The LORD will protect your soul.
The LORD is always watching over you.
He will not let harm come to you.
He will keep your life safe.
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִשְׁמָרְךָ֥ מִכָּל־ רָ֑ע יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת־ נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

passages.text: The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD watches over you.
The LORD watches when you go out.
The LORD watches when you come in.
The LORD does this now.
The LORD will do this forever.
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִשְׁמָר־ צֵאתְךָ֥ וּבוֹאֶ֑ךָ מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
